app.name: Ardoise
app.tagline: Your Bamboo Slate pages, on all your computers.

wizard.title: Welcome to Ardoise
wizard.intro: Choose the folder where Ardoise will keep your notes.
wizard.syncHint: Preferably pick a synced folder (Nextcloud, OneDrive…): your notes will then be available on all your computers.
wizard.machineHint: This choice only applies to this computer ({machine}). On another computer, Ardoise will ask where that same folder is.

wizard.new: A new library will be created in this folder.

deleted.other: Binder "{name}" deleted: {count} notes moved to the trash.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tabletForgetConfirm: Forget the tablet “{name}”? It will have to be registered again, on every computer.

autoExport.title: Automatic export after sync
autoExport.hint: Each page received from the tablet is also saved as a PDF or a PNG in a folder of the library, so you can read your notes on your phone with the Nextcloud app.
autoExport.folderHint: A path relative to the library, for example Exports.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.hint: The microphone used for the narration of videos and live mode. The choice is remembered on this computer.

sharePort.title: Sharing on the network
sharePort.label: Share port
sharePort.hint: The port the share uses on this PC. The other computer types the address with this number. The firewall allows the program, not the port: changing the port does not ask for the permission again. A share that is running keeps its port; the new port is used by the next share.
sharePort.invalid: The port must be a whole number from 1024 to 65535.
sharePort.own: This port is kept for this PC. The other computers that share this settings file keep port {shared}.

penTouch.title: Pen and touch
penTouch.drawWithFingerHint: By default only the pen draws: a finger pans the page, two fingers zoom, a double tap fits the page. Tick this box for a touch screen without a pen; a finger then draws like the mouse.
penTouch.penHint: The back of the pen erases (with the eraser's settings); the pen's button draws a selection lasso; fingers are ignored while the pen is in use or near the screen.

librarySwitch.title: Change the library
librarySwitch.hint: Ardoise will show the notes of this folder at once, on this PC only ({machine}). The notes of the current library stay in their folder.
librarySwitch.current: This is already the library of this PC: nothing changes.

settings.boardForgetConfirm: Forget the Xiaomi tablet? Ardoise will no longer look for it and it will have to be added again, on every computer. It stays linked to Mi Home.

assistant.title: Assistant (MCP)
assistant.intro: An assistant such as Claude Code or Claude Desktop can read your notes, see them as images, clean them up (Markdown, Word, LaTeX), title them and file them, or retouch a copy of one (the original is never changed). Paste the text below into the assistant: Ardoise never edits its configuration itself.
assistant.appTools: Opening a note or driving the live presentation needs Ardoise to be open.

bridge.serving: Link with the open Ardoise: active.
bridge.retrying: Link with the open Ardoise: interrupted, trying again ({detail}).
bridge.anotherCopy: Link with the open Ardoise: handled by another Ardoise window started from this folder.
bridge.unavailable: Link with the open Ardoise: unavailable ({detail}). The assistant's other tools still work.
bridge.off: Link with the open Ardoise: not available on this system.

assistant.readOnlyHint: The assistant can read and see your notes, but neither change them nor drive Ardoise. Recommended when it only needs to read.

code.title: Claude Code
code.hint: Once, in PowerShell or the command prompt (Ardoise is then available in all your projects). Copy the command as it is, quotes around -- included:

desktop.title: Claude Desktop
desktop.hint: In Claude Desktop: Settings > Developer > Edit Config. Add the "ardoise" entry next to the servers already in "mcpServers", save, then quit and restart Claude Desktop.

assistant.copyFailed: Cannot copy: select the text and copy it with Ctrl+C.
assistant.privacy: Privacy: what the assistant reads (the text and image of your notes, sometimes students' names) goes to its provider, under your account's settings. Assistants usually ask for your consent before changing anything, but that depends on their permission settings; Ardoise flags the tools that change or remove notes. Nothing is ever deleted for good, and the assistant never writes the ink of the original: it retouches a copy (what it is asked to do there is not checked: look at the copy). To let it only read, declare it with "Read only" ticked.
assistant.guide: Step by step: the "Assistant" guide, file guide\assistant.en.html in Ardoise's folder.

credits.title: Credits
credits.tuhi: The Bamboo Slate's Bluetooth protocol was understood thanks to Tuhi, the free Linux driver for Wacom SmartPad tablets by Peter Hutterer, Benjamin Tissoires and contributors (https://github.com/tuhiproject/tuhi, GPL-2.0 or later). Tuhi's documentation of the tablet's protocol guided Ardoise, which reimplements it from its own notes and captures: Ardoise contains no Tuhi code.

cisco.title: OpenH264 video encoder
cisco.notice: OpenH264 Video Codec provided by Cisco Systems, Inc.
cisco.download: Ardoise does not contain OpenH264: if Windows cannot write MP4 files, you download it yourself from Cisco, from the Settings. It is then kept on this computer only.

cisco.license: The licence of the binary provided by Cisco is shown in the Settings, under "Backup video encoder (OpenH264)".

tablet.title: Tablet
tablet.unavailableStatus: The tablet status is not available.

settings.none: No tablet is known: add one in the "Tablets" tab.

tablet.simulated: Simulated tablet: no real tablet is being used.

hint.searching: Press the tablet's button briefly to connect it, and keep it close to the computer.
hint.pendingSync: Syncing will start as soon as the tablet is connected.
hint.pendingLive: Live mode will start as soon as the tablet is connected.
hint.searchingBoard: Switch on the Xiaomi tablet and keep it close to the computer. Close Mi Home (or turn off the phone's Bluetooth): it talks to one application at a time.
hint.searchingBoth: Switch on the Xiaomi tablet, or press the Bamboo Slate's button briefly. Close Mi Home (or turn off the phone's Bluetooth): the Xiaomi tablet talks to one application at a time.
hint.adding: Ardoise is looking for a Xiaomi tablet to add.

info.title: Information
info.name: Name
info.notRead: The tablet has not been read yet: its information will appear at the first connection.
info.clockAuto: The Xiaomi tablet's clock is set at every connection; it has no name to change and no version to read.

sync.title: Sync
sync.failedKept: The pages not received stay on the tablet; Ardoise will try again at the next connection (press the tablet's button briefly).
sync.pagesWaiting: {count} pages are waiting on the tablet: only the oldest one can be read until it is deleted. Turn on "{option}" to get them.
sync.boardTitle: The pages will be deleted from the tablet
sync.boardConfirm: The Xiaomi tablet hands over only its oldest page: to reach the next one, Ardoise has to delete each page from the tablet once its note is written and checked. Sync and delete the pages?
sync.boardWaitingOne: 1 page is waiting on the Xiaomi tablet: it is imported only on request, with "Sync", and will be deleted from the tablet once its note is written.
sync.boardWaitingMany: {count} pages are waiting on the Xiaomi tablet: they are imported only on request, with "Sync", and will be deleted from the tablet once their notes are written.
sync.boardOnRequest: The Xiaomi tablet imports its pages only on request: switch it on, then click "Sync" once it is connected.

live.hint: Draw on the tablet and see the stroke appear at once, on a projector too.

options.title: Options
options.autoSyncHint: The tablet's pages are received as soon as it is in range.
options.deleteAfterImport: Delete from the tablet after import
options.deleteAfterImportHint: A page is deleted from the tablet only once its file has been written to the library and checked: if anything fails, it stays on the tablet. The tablet hands over only its oldest page: without this option, the other pages stay unreadable until the first one is deleted.
options.orientationHint: Choose how you hold the tablet: Ardoise turns what you draw so that it appears upright. Upside down suits left-handed users; in portrait, the notes are portrait pages. The button is the one next to the tablet's light.
options.deleteAfterImportBoard: Xiaomi tablet: without this option, its pages are imported only on request ("Sync"), after a confirmation, and they are deleted from the tablet all the same: it is the only way to reach the next page.
options.shared: These two settings apply to all your tablets.
options.boardPositionHint: Ardoise turns what you write so that it appears upright.

orientation.landscapeFlipped: Landscape upside down, button at the top

manage.title: Tablet settings
manage.name: Tablet name
manage.nameInvalid: The name must be 1 to 15 characters long, without accents or special characters.
manage.timeHint: Sets the tablet's clock to the computer's.

register.intro: Register your Bamboo Slate, or add your Xiaomi tablet, to receive its pages automatically and draw live.
register.title: Register the tablet
register.warning: Once registered in Ardoise, the tablet will no longer work with the Wacom phone app or with Inkspace, until you register it there again.
register.warningPhone: Turn off your phone's Bluetooth while registering.
register.drawingLabel: Drawing of the tablet and its button

holdButton.title: Hold the tablet's button
holdButton.text: Hold the button down for about 6 seconds, until the light blinks blue.

searching.title: Looking for the tablet
searching.text: Keep the tablet close to the computer: this can take a few seconds.

connecting.title: Connecting to the tablet
connecting.text: Stay still: Ardoise is introducing itself to the tablet.

pressButton.title: Press the button briefly
pressButton.text: A short press on the tablet's button confirms the registration. You have about 30 seconds.

done.title: Tablet registered
done.text: “{name}” is ready: its pages will be received automatically whenever it is in range.

error.title: The registration did not succeed
error.hint: Check that Bluetooth is on and that the tablet is charged and close to the computer, then start again: hold the button until it blinks blue.

board.title: Add the Xiaomi tablet
board.intro: Switch on the Xiaomi tablet and keep it close to the computer.
board.introMiHome: Close Mi Home, or turn off your phone's Bluetooth: the tablet talks to one application at a time.
board.introLinked: There is no button to hold and no registration: the tablet stays linked to Mi Home, and Ardoise uses neither your Xiaomi account nor its online service.

searching.title: Looking for the Xiaomi tablet
searching.text: This takes a few seconds; the search stops after a minute.

found.many: {count} Xiaomi tablets were found: choose yours. The stronger the signal, the closer the tablet.

added.title: Xiaomi tablet added
added.text: Ardoise connects to the tablet as soon as it is switched on and nothing else is using it. Its pages become notes; each one is deleted from the tablet once its note is written.

error.title: The Xiaomi tablet was not added

tablet.simulatedBoardButton: Press the simulated Xiaomi tablet's button (stores the page)

diagnostic.title: Tablet test
diagnostic.intro: This test checks the link with the Bamboo Slate step by step and records every exchange in the library (_ardoise/diagnostics folder) for analysis. It takes about 5 minutes.
diagnostic.deleteAfterSync: Delete pages from the tablet once added to the library as notes

instruction.drawReferencePages: On the tablet, draw {count} reference pages. After each page, briefly press the tablet's button to save it.
instruction.referenceItem1: a square and a circle, as large as possible;
instruction.referenceItem3: three horizontal lines: very light, normal, very hard.
instruction.holdButtonToRegister: Hold the tablet's button down for about 6 seconds, until the light blinks blue.
instruction.registerWarning: Warning: the tablet will no longer work with the phone app or with Inkspace (you will have to register it there again to go back).
instruction.pressButtonToConfirm: Now briefly press the tablet's button to confirm the registration.
instruction.drawLive: Draw on the tablet without stopping for {seconds} seconds: lines, circles, handwriting, pressing harder and softer.

errorCodes.blackboardNotFound: No Xiaomi tablet found: switch it on, bring it close to the computer and close Mi Home (or turn off the phone's Bluetooth), because it talks to one application at a time.
errorCodes.transferIncomplete: A page of the Xiaomi tablet was not received in full; it stays on the tablet. Bring the tablet closer to the computer and sync again.
errorCodes.pageNotDeleted: The Xiaomi tablet still holds a page that Ardoise has just asked it to delete: the sync stopped. The note of that page is already in the library.
errorCodes.notSupported: This tablet cannot do that (the Xiaomi tablet has no name to change).
errorCodes.blackboardConfirmDelete: The Xiaomi tablet's pages are imported only with your agreement: they are deleted from the tablet once imported, because it gives only its oldest page. Confirm the sync to go on.
errorCodes.pageUnreadable: The Xiaomi tablet sent a page that Ardoise cannot read: that page was not imported and stays on the tablet, and so do the pages stored after it (the tablet gives only its oldest page). Import them with Mi Home, and keep the diagnostic log (the _ardoise\diagnostics folder of the library).
errorCodes.sheetOtherTablet: This sheet cannot be continued with this tablet: a Bamboo Slate sheet is continued with the Bamboo Slate, a page of the Xiaomi tablet with the Xiaomi tablet. This tablet wrote nothing on the note.
errorCodes.blackboardPagesFirst: The Xiaomi tablet still holds {count} stored pages. Erasing its screen during live mode could lose the page of the screen in progress, so import them first. They are deleted from the tablet once imported, and live mode starts afterwards.
errorCodes.blackboardPagesFirstOne: The Xiaomi tablet still holds 1 stored page. Erasing its screen during live mode could lose the page of the screen in progress, so import it first. It is deleted from the tablet once imported, and live mode starts afterwards.
errorCodes.pageRescued: A page of the Xiaomi tablet could not be written in the library, and the tablet no longer holds it: Ardoise kept a rescue copy (the _ardoise\rescued-pages folder of the library, or the Ardoise\blackboard-rescue folder of this PC's local data) and will import it at the next sync. Check that the library can be reached and has room left.
errorCodes.pageDoubtful: A page of the Xiaomi tablet was not received cleanly, and the tablet may no longer hold it: what came is kept apart (the _ardoise\rescued-pages\doubtful folder of the library, or a doubtful folder under Ardoise\blackboard-rescue in this PC's local data) and was not made into a note. If a note of that page was made, check it, and keep the diagnostic log.
errorCodes.pageNotSaved: A page of the Xiaomi tablet could be written neither in the library nor on this PC, and the tablet no longer holds it: Ardoise keeps it in memory and will try again at the next sync. Do not close Ardoise until then; make the library reachable or free some room, then sync again.
errorCodes.sheetBoardPosition: This page of the Xiaomi tablet is not the same way round as the tablet is held: a wide page is continued with the tablet held wide (buttons on the right or on the left), an upright page with the tablet held upright (buttons at the bottom or at the top). To continue it, choose a position of the same way round as the page in the Xiaomi tablet's settings, hold the tablet that way, then resume live mode; or resume live mode on another sheet. Nothing was written on the note.
errorCodes.boardPositionFixed: This live mode writes on a page of the Xiaomi tablet that keeps its shape (a resumed sheet, or a page written over an image): only the two positions of the same way round as that page are possible until live mode ends. The position did not change.

editor.backTitle: Back to the library (Esc when nothing else is open or selected)
editor.title: Title of the note
editor.conflictHint: Your changes are still shown here, but saving them would overwrite the other version. Save them as a copy to keep them, or go back to the library and reopen the note to see the latest version.

disk.changedClean: It was probably changed on another computer. Reload it to see the latest version.
disk.changedDirty: It was probably changed on another computer: saving now would be refused so as not to overwrite the other version. Save your changes as a copy.
disk.missingTitle: This note is no longer in the library
disk.missing: It may have been deleted or moved on another computer. Save it as a copy to keep it.

pages.label: Move to another page
pages.videoBusy: A video export is running: wait for it to finish or cancel it before changing page.

revision.label: Retouched copy
revision.gone: The original is not in the library
revision.videoBusy: A video export is running: wait for it to finish or cancel it before opening the original.

account.title: What changed
account.byAssistant: This account is written by the assistant that retouched the note.
account.empty: No account comes with this copy.

comparison.title: Compare with the original
comparison.unsaved: This copy is shown as it is saved: its unsaved changes are not in it.

shapeTools.label: Shape options
shapeTools.regularHint: Square, circle; a line snaps to horizontal, vertical or a 45° diagonal. Holding Shift inverts this setting for one stroke.
shapeTools.centreHint: The first point is the centre of the shape (a line grows both ways). Holding Alt inverts this setting for one stroke.
shapeTools.snapHint: Points snap to the page's paper: intersections of squared, millimetre and dotted paper; the rules of ruled paper; the rules and large squares of Seyès.
shapeTools.snapDisabled: This paper has no lines to snap to: choose ruled, Seyès, squared, millimetre or dotted paper (Page tab).

text.label: Text options
text.help: Tap the page to type a text, or a text to change it · Enter: new line · Esc: finish

bookmark.help: Tap the page to put a bookmark, or a bookmark to rename it · Enter: confirm · Esc: finish
bookmark.placeholder: A word or a short phrase
bookmark.gone: This bookmark no longer exists in the note.

editor.selectHelp: Lasso: select · Shift+lasso: add · Ctrl+lasso: remove · Double-click a text: change it · F: straighten shapes · Esc: deselect all

clipboard.nothing: The clipboard holds no strokes nor texts copied in Ardoise.

straighten.hint: Turns the selected strokes that look like a line, a circle, an ellipse, a rectangle or an arrow into clean shapes (F key). Other strokes, handwriting included, stay as they are.
straighten.disabledHint: Select strokes with the lasso first, then straighten them.
straighten.none: No shape recognised in the selection. Ardoise straightens lines and arrows at least {line} mm long, and circles, ellipses and rectangles at least {closed} mm across, drawn clearly enough (setting: the small button to the right of the button). Select the drawings rather than the text: a small upright oval (under 2.5 cm) looks like an O or a 0 and stays as it is, like everything else that is not a clear shape.

settings.title: Straighten shapes

count.noSelection: Select strokes with the lasso to see what would be straightened.
count.none: With these values, no shape is recognised in the selection.

tolerance.label: Tolerance
tolerance.help: Lenient also straightens shapes drawn less clearly; strict, only the clearest ones.

size.label: Minimum size
size.help: Lines and arrows at least {line} mm long; circles, ellipses and rectangles at least {closed} mm across.
size.warning: Below 1 cm, letters may be straightened: select only the drawings.

snap.label: Automatic alignment
snap.angle: Make nearly horizontal or vertical strokes exactly so
snap.round: Make a circle or a square of nearly round or square shapes

settings.applyNone: No shape to straighten with these values.
settings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved: {message}

page.rotateCcw: Rotate the page a quarter turn to the left
page.rotateCw: Rotate the page a quarter turn to the right
page.cropHint: Draw on the page the rectangle to keep.
page.orientationHint: The writing does not turn: only the sheet changes direction, and the writing keeps its place.
page.scaleInk: Scale the writing with the sheet
page.scaleInkOn: The writing and the background image are scaled with the sheet, without distortion.
page.scaleInkOff: The writing keeps its size and place. If it goes beyond the sheet, it is moved back inside when it fits; otherwise the part outside is kept but not shown.
page.inkOutsideOne: One stroke goes beyond the sheet: it is kept but not shown.
page.inkOutsideMany: {count} strokes go beyond the sheet: they are kept but not shown.
page.rotateHint: The sheet, the writing and the background image turn together by a quarter turn.

original.label: Original
original.helpTablet: Get the ink back as it came from the tablet, without your edits (with the tablet orientation currently chosen in the settings).
original.helpFirst: Get back the ink of the first saved version that had any, without the edits made since.
original.helpBlank: Get back the blank sheet from before live mode, without the ink added since.
original.none: No original yet: the first time you save a change of the ink, Ardoise keeps the version before it, if it had any ink.
original.confirmLost: Your edits of the ink will be lost: strokes added, erased, moved, straightened or recoloured, layers, page rotation, format and cropping.
original.confirmKept: The title, tags, favourite, paper and narration stay as they are. Only slate paper goes back to the original's paper, if it had another. The background image stays too: it goes back to its original place if the note already had it, otherwise it is placed upright on the restored page.
original.confirmUndo: You can still undo (Ctrl+Z); save to keep the result.
original.done: Original ink restored: save to keep it, or Ctrl+Z to undo.
original.failed: The original could not be read: {message}

layers.hiddenActive: The chosen layer is hidden: show it or choose another one to draw.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.fitWidthTitle: Fit the page to the window's width (Ctrl + 2)

touch.drawTitle: Draw with a finger (otherwise a finger pans the page; two fingers zoom; a double tap fits the page)

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.message: This note has changes that have not been saved.
leave.saveSwitch: Save and open the other note

split.hint: Move part of the note into a new note
split.title: Split the note
split.timeHint: Everything written from this instant on moves to a new note. The strokes concerned are coloured on the page.
split.zoneHint: Trace the zone to cut out on the page, like with the lasso: the strokes that are mostly inside it move to the new note.
split.zoneTraced: The coloured strokes move to the new note. Trace again to change the zone.
split.nothing: Nothing to split this way: each note must keep at least one stroke.
split.dirtyHint: Your unsaved changes will be saved along with the split.
split.empty: This note is empty: there is nothing to split.

copyImage.hint: Copy the note as an image to the clipboard (for Word, OneNote…)
copyImage.done: Image copied: paste it into Word, OneNote or another program.

export.hint: Export the note as PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF

print.hint: Print the note, each note on its own page, in its orientation

replay.hint: Replay the strokes as they were written (R)
replay.recordingBusy: Stop or cancel the narration recording first.

video.hint: Export the replay as a video (MP4, WebM) or an animated image (GIF, WebP)…

editor.backgroundLoadFailed: This note's background image could not be loaded ({message}). The note opens without it; the image stays in the file unless you remove it.

list.panHold: Move the page while the key is held (unless a button has the focus)
list.straighten: Straighten the shapes of the selection
list.selectAll: Select all (the strokes and texts of the chosen layer)
list.clipboard: Copy, cut, paste strokes and texts
list.escape: Esc, in steps: cancels the gesture under way or finishes typing a text or a bookmark (the text stays); else closes the open split, replay, crop or “Straighten shapes” setting; else deselects; else saves the note and goes back to the library (not while a sound is being recorded)
list.fitWidth: Width: the page across the window
list.pages: Previous page, next page (the note before, the note after)
list.close: Back to the library (first closes the split or the replay)

sound.replayFirst: A narration is heard and recorded during a replay.
sound.writingHelp: The sound and what you write on the computer (pen, mouse, or finger when “Draw with a finger” is on) are recorded together: the replay plays them back together, after what the note already holds.
sound.recordWritingHint: Talk while writing: the strokes take the time of the sound
sound.writingInfo: The strokes written during the recording take the time of the sound.
sound.writingSave: When you stop, the note is saved with the sound and what you wrote.
sound.writingDuring: Write: your strokes follow the sound.
sound.notSaved: The sound is kept in memory: it goes into the note the next time it is saved.

projection.help: The editor's page full screen on the projector, updated at every stroke. It stops when you leave the editor.
projection.zoneHint: The projected area follows what the editor shows; a dashed frame shows it on the page.
projection.widthTitle: Show the page across the projector's width

dot.warn: a layer in use is hidden

help.typingEditor: They do nothing while you type in a text field, except Ctrl + S, Ctrl + W, Ctrl + F4 and Ctrl + Q.
help.typingLive: They do nothing while you type in a text field, except Ctrl + W, Ctrl + F4 and Ctrl + Q. Space turns the page even when a button has the focus.

chosen.editor: The pen, the eraser and the selection act on “{name}”

warn.tabletHidden: The tablet writes on “{name}”, which is hidden: what the pupil writes is neither projected nor shared.
warn.chosenHidden: The chosen layer, “{name}”, is hidden: show it to write on it.

help.editor: The pen, the eraser and the selection act on the chosen layer (framed).
help.live: The computer's pen, its eraser and the selection act on the chosen layer (framed). The tablet writes on the one marked with the tablet icon.

replay.narrationLocks: Speed and dead time are those of the narration.
replay.audioFailed: The narration sound cannot be played.
replay.empty: This note has no strokes to replay.
replay.locked: Recording: the replay runs on its own, without pausing or changing speed.

status.waiting: Waiting for sound from the microphone…
status.noData: The microphone sends nothing. Check that it is plugged in properly, or choose another one.
status.silent: Windows may be blocking access to the microphone: open Settings > Privacy & security > Microphone and turn on "Let desktop apps access your microphone". A microphone mute switch gives the same result.

record.openHint: Talk while the replay plays: the sound is recorded in the note
record.replaces: A new recording replaces the current narration.
record.settings: The sound will follow the replay with its current settings: speed {speed}, {pauses}.
record.afterEnd: The replay is over; the recording goes on and the last image stays on screen.
record.saveNote: The sound is added to the note as it is saved on disk: unsaved changes are not part of it.
record.unsavedWarning: This note has unsaved changes. Save it first (Ctrl+S), otherwise they will not be kept with the narration.
record.replaceQuestion: This note already has a narration ({duration}). Replace it with this new recording?

pending.title: Recording on hold
pending.message: The narration could not be added to the note, but it is kept. Fix the problem (for example by reopening the note or saving a copy), then try again.
pending.messageElsewhere: A recording could not be added to its note, but it is kept. Open a note in the editor to try again (Replay, then Record a narration), or discard it.
pending.discardConfirm: Discard this recording for good? The sound will be lost.

stored.deleteFailed: The narration could not be deleted: {message}

export.title: Export
export.includeSubBindersHint: The notes of each sub-binder come after those of the binder, in that sub-binder's order; the sub-binders follow the sidebar's order.
export.binderPdfHint: A single PDF, one page per note ({count} in all), in the binder's order. Each note is a bookmark of the PDF, filed under the name of its sub-binder.

formatPros.png: Sharp and lossless, optional transparent background. Ideal for Word, OneNote or a slide.
formatPros.jpg: Opens everywhere and is accepted by every website and form (some accept only JPG).
formatPros.webp: Sharp and lossless like PNG, but about a quarter smaller; transparent background possible. Great for the web and messaging.
formatPros.svg: Vector: sharp at any size, keeps the stroke width given by the pen pressure, editable in Inkscape.
formatPros.pdf: Vector and sharp when printed; several notes make a single file. Ideal for printing or sharing.

formatCons.png: Gets blurry when enlarged a lot; heavier with a textured paper.
formatCons.jpg: No transparent background, slight blur around the strokes; often heavier than PNG for a note on plain paper.
formatCons.webp: Less universal: some older programs, websites and forms cannot open it; gets blurry when enlarged.
formatCons.svg: Not accepted everywhere (school platforms, older software); heavy for a very full note.
formatCons.pdf: Less handy to insert into a document or to edit.

compare.title: Which format should I choose?

size.label: File size
size.svg: Depends on the number of strokes

bestFor.label: Ideal for
bestFor.jpg: A website or form that requires JPG

compare.advice: When in doubt: PDF to print or send a note, PNG to insert it into a document. WebP gives the same result as PNG in a smaller file, if the program receiving it knows the format. JPG is only for when a website requires it.

export.background: Include the background (paper, lines, texture, background image)

backgroundHints.png: Unchecked: the background is transparent, only the ink is exported.
backgroundHints.jpg: Unchecked: the background is white (JPG can't be transparent).
backgroundHints.webp: Unchecked: the background is transparent, only the ink is exported.
backgroundHints.svg: Unchecked: only the ink is exported, without paper.
backgroundHints.pdf: Unchecked: only the ink is exported, without paper.

separateHint.svg: One Inkscape layer per layer of the note, to show or hide in Inkscape.
separateHint.pdf: PDF layers, to show or hide in Acrobat Reader or Firefox. Some readers show them all, with no choice.

layers.flat: An image has no layers: they are always merged.
layers.hiddenNever: Layers hidden in Ardoise are never exported: a hidden layer may hold the answers.

export.destinationFile: You'll choose the file to create next.
export.destinationFolder: Each note becomes one file, in the folder you'll choose. Existing files are never overwritten.
export.destinationPdfMany: All the notes go into a single PDF, one page per note, in the order shown. You'll choose the file to create next.
export.rasterTooLarge: Even at the lowest resolution this page would give an image over 16,384 pixels on a side. Export it as PDF or SVG instead.
export.dpiLimitHint: Resolutions that would give an image over 16,384 pixels on a side are not offered; use PDF or SVG for the largest pages.

print.title: Print
print.intro: Windows opens its print window so that you can choose the printer, the number of copies and the pages. Each note is printed on a page of its own, in its orientation (portrait or landscape), unless you put several on a sheet.
print.binderHint: Notes to print: {count}, in the binder's order.
print.background: Print the background (paper, lines, texture, background image)
print.backgroundHint: Unchecked: only the writing is printed, on white paper.
print.fitActual: Real size (reduced only if the note is larger than the sheet)
print.perSheetHint: The notes are laid out in order on the sheet, each in its own cell, without being distorted. In the Windows window the pages are the sheets: "1-2" prints the first two sheets.

videoExport.title: Export as video

formatPros.mp4: Plays everywhere: Windows, phones, PowerPoint, school portals. With the sound of the narration.
formatPros.gif: Plays without a player: in an e-mail, a web page or a slide. Loops.
formatPros.webp: Like GIF, but smaller and sharper; transparent background possible.
formatPros.webm: Open format, with sound, small files. Plays in browsers and in Moodle.

formatCons.gif: No sound, only 256 colours, large files.
formatCons.webp: No sound; some older programs cannot open it.
formatCons.webm: Slow export (AV1 encoding); some Windows players cannot open it.

compare.title: Which format should I choose?

plays.label: Plays with
plays.mp4: Everything: Windows, phones, PowerPoint, school portals
plays.gif: Browser, e-mail, slide: no player needed

bestFor.label: Best for
bestFor.mp4: A video lesson with my voice, PowerPoint, school portals
bestFor.gif: A short demonstration in an e-mail or a slide
bestFor.webp: A sharp animation on a web page, with transparency
bestFor.webm: Uploading to Moodle or a website, small file

compare.advice: When in doubt: MP4, which plays everywhere and carries the sound. GIF for a short animation that must show without a player.

videoExport.pageHint: The video keeps the page's proportions, with 1920 pixels on the long side.
videoExport.trimPausesHint: Long pauses between two strokes are shortened to half a second.
videoExport.backgroundFixed: The background is always the paper: this format has no transparency.
videoExport.narrationHint: The sound recorded with the microphone is added to the video.
videoExport.narrationLocked: The narration keeps the speed it was recorded at ({speed}×): the speed, the target duration and the dead time cannot be changed.
videoExport.narrationNoSound: This note has a narration, but GIF and WebP have no sound: choose MP4 or WebM to include it.
videoExport.invalidTiming: The target duration must be between 1 and 3600 seconds.
videoExport.invalidHold: The last frame can stay on screen for 0 to 60 seconds.

estimate.long: This export will take a while. To go faster, choose a smaller image size, fewer frames per second or another format (WebM is the slowest).

videoExport.destination: You will then choose the file to create.
videoExport.closeBusy: A video export is running: wait for it to finish or cancel it before closing the window.

openh264.title: Backup video encoder (OpenH264)
openh264.intro: To write MP4 videos, Ardoise uses the encoder built into Windows (Media Foundation). It is missing on Windows "N" editions installed without the Media Feature Pack: Ardoise can then download the OpenH264 encoder from Cisco and keep it in its local folder.
openh264.mediaFoundationOk: Windows can write MP4 files on this PC: the backup is not needed.
openh264.mediaFoundationMissing: Windows cannot write MP4 files on this PC. Install the backup below, or choose WebM for your videos.

status.label: Status
status.damaged: Damaged file: remove it, then download it again

openh264.downloadHint: The file comes from Cisco's server; its fingerprint is checked before it is installed. Its licence is shown below.
openh264.allow: Allow Ardoise to use OpenH264 for MP4 files
openh264.allowHint: Unticked, the file stays installed but is not used.

live.title: Live mode

orientation.label: Tablet position
orientation.hint: Changes at once: the page in progress turns with the tablet, with what is already drawn on it.

resume.hint: Resumes live mode on this sheet: what you write on the tablet is added to the note.
resume.noTablet: Resuming in live mode needs a registered tablet: register it from the tablet panel.
resume.tabletBusy: The tablet is busy (sync or registration under way).
resume.severalSelected: Select a single note to resume in live mode.
resume.failed: Live mode could not resume this sheet.
resume.cannotTurn: This page does not turn with the tablet: it is a resumed sheet, or a page written over an image. A new page follows the tablet's position again.
resume.hold: To write on this sheet, hold the tablet like this: {position}.

forked.changed: This sheet was changed elsewhere during live mode: so that nothing is overwritten, the writing continues in a new note, next to it.
forked.deleted: This sheet was deleted elsewhere during live mode: the writing continues in a new note.

waiting.title: Press the tablet's button briefly to connect it.
waiting.hint: Live mode starts as soon as the tablet is connected: what you write shows here and on the projected screen.
waiting.titleBoard: Switch on the Xiaomi tablet to connect it.
waiting.titleBoth: Switch on the Xiaomi tablet, or press the Bamboo Slate's button briefly.
waiting.hintBoard: Close Mi Home (or turn off the phone's Bluetooth). Live mode starts as soon as the tablet is connected: what you write shows here and on the projected screen.

live.reconnecting: The link with the tablet was lost: reconnecting…
live.stopHint: Ends live mode: each page is saved as a note of the library.
live.stopFailed: Live mode did not stop properly.

stopped.narration: The narration could not be added to the pages

live.recordingLost: The narration being recorded could not be kept: {message}
live.commandFailed: The command did not go through: {message}

saveFailed.one: A page could not be saved to the library.
saveFailed.many: {count} pages could not be saved to the library.
saveFailed.advice: The pages stay in memory: check the library folder (disk space, write permission, sync). When Ardoise closes, a backup copy is written to Ardoise's local folder. This message goes away as soon as a save succeeds.

pen.hint: Write with the computer's pen or mouse on the chosen layer (P)
pen.help: Pen or mouse: write · eraser end of the pen: erase whole strokes of the chosen layer · finger: move and zoom the projected area.
pen.styleHint: Choose the computer's tool, colour and width

select.hint: Pick strokes with a lasso or a click to delete them, change their colour, move them or resize them (V)
select.help: Lasso: select · click: one stroke · Shift: add · Ctrl: remove · Esc: deselect. Drag inside the frame to move the selection, or by a corner to resize it (pen, finger or mouse). The colour swatches change the colour of the selection. Only strokes of the chosen layer are picked.
select.colors: The colour swatches recolour the selection.

live.undoHint: Undo the computer's last action: a stroke, an erasing, a touch-up or the clearing of the page (Ctrl+Z); what the tablet wrote is not undone

preview.label: Preview of page {page}; the blue rectangle shows the projected area
preview.hint: Drag the blue rectangle to move the projected area; the mouse wheel zooms.

zoom.label: Zoom of the projected area
zoom.fitWidthTitle: Show the page across the projected area's width (W)

projection.single: Only one screen is detected: the presentation will cover this window. Press Esc to close it.

latency.label: Latency
latency.detail: Median of the last {count} points; 95 % under {p95} ms; interface share (from the batch's arrival to the end of the drawing): {ui} ms.
latency.hint: Time from the computer receiving a point to the start of the next frame after it was drawn; the screen's own scan-out is not included (target: under 30 ms).

zoom.action: Zoom the projected area in / out

leave.action: Drop the pen gesture under way, close the “Computer's ink” panel, deselect; otherwise close the projection when it is shown, otherwise end live mode (after confirmation)

close.action: Close the projection if it is shown, otherwise end live mode (after confirmation)

marks.action: Clear the annotations drawn over the presentation

pen.action: Pen tool: write with the computer's pen or mouse

select.action: Select tool (lasso or click on a stroke; drag inside the frame to move, by a corner to resize)

undo.action: Undo, redo a stroke or an erasing of the computer, a delete, a change of colour or the clearing of the page

narration.title: Narration
narration.openHint: Talk during the session: the sound is recorded with the pages
narration.hint: The sound is cut page by page and saved with each note; the note's replay plays it back.
narration.savedNone: No page of the session has any strokes: the narration was not kept.

live.clearUndoFailed: The clearing can no longer be undone: the page has changed since.

merge.title: Merge “{upper}” into “{lower}”?
merge.noUndo: Ctrl+Z will not be able to undo it.
merge.hidden: “{lower}” is hidden: once merged, its content will be projected and shared.

failed.layersStale: The page changed in the meantime: do the layer operation again.
failed.pen: This stroke could not be written.
failed.eraser: This erasing could not be done.
failed.paper: The page's paper could not be changed.
failed.image: The background image could not be changed.
failed.pageStale: The page changed in the meantime: choose again.

leave.title: End live mode?
leave.message: Every page you wrote is saved as a note in the library. To stop only the projection, use "Stop projecting": Esc also closes it while it is shown.

quit.title: Quit Ardoise?
quit.message: Live mode stops and every page you wrote is saved as a note in the library.

pagesFirst.title: Import the tablet's pages first
pagesFirst.failed: The pages could not be imported: {reason}
pagesFirst.lost: The tablet is no longer connected: the import stopped. Pages that were not imported stay on the tablet.

page.help: For the current page, on the projector and on the share too. A new page keeps this paper.
page.board: Blackboard on: the paper's colour comes back when it is turned off (B). The template and the texture apply at once.
page.slate: To write in chalk, turn the blackboard on instead (B).
page.back: To go back, choose the previous setting again: Ctrl+Z only undoes what the computer writes.

background.help: Under the writing of the current page: a worksheet or a document to fill in front of the class. The next page has no image.

xiaomi.label: Xiaomi tablet position
xiaomi.note: Changes at once: the page in progress turns with what is already written on it, and the position chosen stays in the Xiaomi tablet's settings. Its button stores the page on the tablet without stopping live mode; "Next page" is done from the computer.
xiaomi.fixedPortrait: Upright page: buttons at the bottom or at the top
xiaomi.fixedLandscape: Wide page: buttons on the right or on the left
xiaomi.fixedHint: This live mode writes on a page that keeps its shape (a resumed sheet, or a page written over an image): the Xiaomi tablet is held the same way round as that page until live mode ends. The two other positions would write sideways.

share.buttonHint: Show this screen in the browser of another computer on the local network

buttonActive.one: Sharing: 1 screen connected. Open the share.
buttonActive.other: Sharing: {count} screens connected. Open the share.

indicatorHint.one: Sharing on the network: 1 screen connected. Click to open the share.
indicatorHint.other: Sharing on the network: {count} screens connected. Click to open the share.

share.open: On the other computer, open a browser and type:
share.httpHint: The whole address, with http:// (not https://): if the browser changes it to https://, remove the "s".
share.noAddress: Ardoise finds no network address on this PC: check that it is connected to the Wi-Fi or the school's network, then stop and start the share again.
share.qr: QR code of the share's address
share.qrHint: Or scan it with a phone.
share.paused: Paused: the shared image is frozen
share.portMoved: Port {requested} is used by another program: the share uses port {port}, kept for this PC.
share.helpFirewall: The first time, Windows asks for the firewall's permission: allow it for private networks ("Private network").
share.helpEnd: The share stops when you decide, or when you close Ardoise. Only the Ardoise computer sends: the other screens just watch.

block.title: Network sharing
block.idle: Another computer on the network shows the page in a browser.

search.label: Results in the handwriting
search.indexing: Reading the handwriting is under way ({done} of {total} notes): more results may still appear.
search.paused: Reading the handwriting is paused during live mode or the presentation ({done} of {total} notes): the search does not see every note yet.
search.stopped: Reading the handwriting is stopped ({done} of {total} notes): resume it in the settings to search every note.
search.noRecognizer: The handwriting is not searched: no Windows handwriting recognizer is installed for this language (see the settings).
search.unsupported: Searching the handwriting is only possible on Windows.

settings.title: Handwriting recognition
settings.intro: Ardoise reads your handwriting for the library search and the text export. Everything happens on this PC, offline, with Windows' own handwriting recognition.
settings.autoHint: Automatic: the interface language when its recognizer is installed on this PC, else the first one installed. This choice applies to all your PCs.
settings.missing: Windows' handwriting pack for this language ({language}) is not installed on this PC.

install.fr: To add it: Windows Settings > Time & language > Language & region; add French if it is not in the list, then “…” > Language options > Handwriting > Download. Then restart Ardoise. Ardoise never downloads anything itself.
install.en: To add it: Windows Settings > Time & language > Language & region; add English if it is not in the list, then “…” > Language options > Handwriting > Download. Then restart Ardoise. Ardoise never downloads anything itself.

settings.unsupported: Handwriting recognition is only available on Windows.
settings.privacy: The recognised text stays on this PC (in its local folder): it is never written into your notes nor synchronised.

status.idleFailed: Notes read: {done} of {total}; {failed} could not be read.
status.paused: Paused during live mode or the presentation ({done} of {total} notes).
status.noRecognizer: No note is read: there is no recognizer for this language.
status.noLibrary: No library is chosen on this PC.

export.title: Recognised text (handwriting)
export.hint: The handwriting of the note (or of the selected notes) read by Windows: each note with its title, one after the other. As plain text, or as Markdown and Word, which keep the structure: the title, the date and the tags at the top, then the paragraphs, the lists and the drawings (images). Recognition can make mistakes: read the text over.
export.drawingsHelp: Diagrams and figures, as pictures between the paragraphs. A line drawn under words does not become a picture: those words are underlined (bold in Markdown).
export.noDrawings: No drawing found: the text alone is exported.
export.failed: The text could not be exported: {message}
export.empty: No text recognised in this note.
export.guessed: Windows could not analyse the layout: the paragraphs, lists and drawings were guessed from the text and may be less accurate.
export.savedImages: Drawings saved in the folder next to it: {count}

editor.title: Background image or PDF
editor.hint: To annotate a worksheet, a document or a photo: the image or PDF page goes under the writing.
editor.choose: Choose a PDF or an image…
editor.pickTitle: Image or PDF to put in the background
editor.pdfPages: {name}: {count} pages. Which one goes in the background?
editor.unreadable: This note's image cannot be read, so it is not shown.
editor.failed: This file cannot be put in the background: {message}
editor.orientationOffer: This image is {image} and the note is {note}. Switch the note to {image}?
editor.turnCcw: Turn the image a quarter turn to the left (the sheet and the writing stay in place)
editor.turnCw: Turn the image a quarter turn to the right (the sheet and the writing stay in place)

library.open: From a PDF or an image…
library.openHint: New note from a PDF or an image: one note per PDF page, to write over
library.title: New note from a PDF or an image
library.intro: Each PDF page becomes a note of its size and orientation (portrait or landscape), with the page in the background; an image becomes a note the size of an A4 sheet, in the image's orientation.
library.pageListInvalid: Type page numbers from 1 to {count}, for example 1-3, 5.
library.imageInfo: One note will be created with this image in the background.

assemble.droppedOne: Only the first note's background image is kept: one other note's will not be carried over.
assemble.droppedMany: Only the first note's background image is kept: those of the {count} other notes will not be carried over.

drafts.shutdownReason: A note has unsaved changes. Go back to Ardoise to save it.
drafts.writeFailed: The backup copy of your changes could not be written ({message}). Remember to save the note.
drafts.restoredCopy: The recovered changes are in the new note “{title}”.

recovery.title: Recovered changes
recovery.restoreText: Ardoise closed before this note was saved. Its changes were kept (last copy on {date}).
recovery.copyText: Ardoise closed before this note was saved, and the note has changed since (on another computer, for instance). Its changes (last copy on {date}) can be recovered into a new note, leaving this one as it is.

library.title: Ardoise closed without saving some changes. Notes concerned: {count}
library.discardConfirm: Discard the changes of “{title}” for good?

notesAtLeast.one: It holds at least {count} note (the folder is very large: the count stopped there).
notesAtLeast.other: It holds at least {count} notes (the folder is very large: the count stopped there).

inkspace.title: Import from Wacom Inkspace
inkspace.intro: Ardoise can take over the notes written with Wacom Inkspace. Inkspace's data is neither changed nor deleted.
inkspace.detecting: Looking for Inkspace on this computer…
inkspace.alreadyOne: including 1 imported before (in the library or its trash), which will be skipped
inkspace.already: including {count} imported before (in the library or its trash), which will be skipped
inkspace.notFound: Ardoise did not find Wacom Inkspace on this computer. If you have a copy of Inkspace's “LocalState” folder (on a USB stick, for example), choose it.
inkspace.binderHint: Leave empty to put the notes at the root of the library.
inkspace.allImported: All of Inkspace's notes were imported before (they are in the library or its trash): there is nothing to import.
inkspace.allReadableImported: All of Inkspace's readable notes were imported before (they are in the library or its trash): there is nothing to import.
inkspace.importedRootOne: 1 note imported at the root of the library
inkspace.importedRoot: {count} notes imported at the root of the library
inkspace.skippedOne: 1 imported before (in the library or its trash), skipped
inkspace.skipped: {count} imported before (in the library or its trash), skipped
inkspace.cancelledHint: The notes already imported are complete. Run the import again to add the others: those already in the library will be skipped.

wizard.found: Ardoise found Wacom Inkspace notes on this computer.
wizard.foundCountOne: Ardoise found Wacom Inkspace notes on this computer (1 note).
wizard.foundCount: Ardoise found Wacom Inkspace notes on this computer ({count} notes).
wizard.hint: You will confirm the import before it starts.

viewer.title: Ardoise: shared screen
viewer.canvas: Page shared by the Ardoise PC
viewer.slow: The connection is taking a while. A web filter on this network may be holding it back: IT can then allow the Ardoise PC's address.

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.text: The Ardoise PC is not sharing anything right now. The page will appear here as soon as sharing starts.

ended.title: Sharing has ended
ended.text: This page will resume by itself if the Ardoise PC shares again (a new code may be asked for).

tooMany.title: Too many screens connected
tooMany.text: The Ardoise PC has reached the number of screens it accepts. Trying again automatically in a few seconds.

code.help: Enter the code shown on the Ardoise PC.
code.label: Sharing code (6 characters)
code.tooMany: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds} s.
code.network: Cannot reach the Ardoise PC. Check the network, then try again.
code.error: The Ardoise PC refused the request (error {status}).
code.cookies: The code is right, but the browser did not keep the permission. Allow cookies for this page, then try again.

view.label: Display of this screen
view.widthTitle: Show the page across the full width of the screen (W)
view.followTitle: Go back to the view chosen on the Ardoise PC (Esc)
